newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TURKISH HOOLIGANS BANNED FROM MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURKISH HOOLIGANS BANNED FROM MATCHES.

text.p: Hundreds of Turkish soccer hooligans have been banned from stadiums in Istanbul for unruly behaviour.
Police registered 700 fans in the city last season for shouting obscenities at players and referees.
They cannot attend league matches from the start of the Turkish championship on August 1, police said.
The ban follows increased violence at games, including several fatal stabbings and deaths from celebratory gunfire.
